title: OpenLVLM-MIA: A Controlled Benchmark Revealing the Limits of Membership Inference Attacks on Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying statistical differences between member (training) and non-member (holdout) image sets using a Classifier Two-Sample Test (C2ST) on DINOv2 visual embeddings, Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), and Fréchet Distance (FID).
